retainedV2SemanticProjection.mergeAlgorithm: Start from the exact parsed v2 object; remove exactly replacedSelectors; retain every inheritedTopLevelSelectors value by exact recursive type/value/order equality; overlay the named v4 sections. Any absent, extra, reordered array, changed scalar/type, or unlisted overlay rejects v4.

schemaLanguageV4.closedMap: A record contains exactly its variant required fields plus explicitly listed optional fields; every other field rejects the candidate at artifact time or faults a hostile runtime state/event before semantic use.
schemaLanguageV4.taggedUnion: The declared discriminator is required and exact; exactly one variant tag matches; unknown tags reject candidate/runtime input according to its boundary.
schemaLanguageV4.exactType: JSON boolean is not integer; uint64 is an integer in 0..18446744073709551615; strings/enums are exact NFC scalar values. Null is admitted if and only if the nominal type's exact jsonType declaration contains null. When enum is present, every value including null must independently occur in that enum. nullable-uint64 is exactly uint64-or-null with boolean excluded; nullable-boolean is exactly boolean-or-null. No coercion, default, truthiness, widening, checker exception or numeric conversion exists.
schemaLanguageV4.array: definite ordered array with declared bounds; uniqueness is exact recursive equality; no implicit sorting.

referencePathGrammar.resolution: exact match in allowedReferencePaths; prefix, alias, case fold, map traversal and unknown fields reject artifact

schemaLanguageV4.artifactFailure: Any ill-typed, inconsistent, unknown-field, unknown-op, unavailable-reference, over-bound, duplicate-ID/priority, selector-incompatible or invariant AST rejects the candidate before execution.
schemaLanguageV4.runtimeFailure: Fault absorption is evaluated before shape validation. An input object whose phase is exactly FAULT is returned recursively unchanged even if another field is malformed. For any other input object, runtime missing reference, wrong type, overflow, malformed state/event or invariant failure returns a recursive copy of the exact original object with only phase overwritten or inserted as FAULT; every other known, unknown, missing, wrongly typed and insertion-ordered field is preserved without normalization, synthesis or deletion, and no staged write commits. A non-object state is outside the transition-state domain and returns the closed REJECT_NON_OBJECT_STATE result without inventing a state record.

transitionTransactionV4.closedResultRequirement: Every invocation returns exactly one transitionResultUnionV4 variant; implementations may not throw, return a bare state, invent a result field or use a checker-only fate.
orderedAlgorithm: If state is an object and state.phase is exactly FAULT, return ABSORB_UNCHANGED before any closed-shape, type, event or invariant check.
If state is not an object, return REJECT_NON_OBJECT_STATE without manufacturing a state.
Validate state and event closed shapes. On failure return RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at runtime-shape from the exact original object.
Evaluate pre-invariants. On false or evaluation failure return RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at pre-invariant from the exact original object.
If terminalOutputPrecheck matches, stage only phase=FAULT and immediately return CONTROLLED_FAULT_COMMIT owned by terminal-output-precheck; frame precheck and rule selection do not run.

For a frame, evaluate framePrecheck against the original valid state. Reject or evaluation failure returns RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at frame-precheck. Accept stages the exact direction counter increment.

Select the first matching rule. Guard failure returns RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at guard-evaluation. Action failure returns RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at action-evaluation. No match returns RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at no-rule.
A non-fallback rule stages its actions and proposes COMMIT. T028 stages phase=FAULT on top of every accepted-frame precheck write and proposes CONTROLLED_FAULT_COMMIT owned by T028-TOTAL-FALLBACK.
Evaluate post-invariants on the staged state. False or evaluation failure returns RUNTIME_FAULT_ROLLBACK at post-invariant from the exact original object.
Publish the staged state exactly once and return the proposed COMMIT or CONTROLLED_FAULT_COMMIT result.
transitionTransactionV4.faultFromOriginalObjectAlgorithm: Construct a new JSON object by visiting the exact original object's members once in insertion order, recursively copying each member; replace the value of an existing phase member with the string FAULT without moving it, or append phase=FAULT if absent. Do not validate, normalize, synthesize or delete any other member.
transitionTransactionV4.controlledVersusRuntimeFault: Terminal output and T028 are explicit valid controlled transitions and therefore commit staged writes. Shape, invariant, guard, action, overflow, rejected-frame and no-rule failures are runtime failures and therefore publish no staged write.

transitionRuleSchemaV4.staticCompatibility: Every event reference in guard/actions must be non-null for every frameType selected by eventSelector. Process selectors cannot read frame-only fields. phaseIn/eventSelector pairs not selected by a preceding rule are owned by the exact fallback.
